g.text: BP_MODE=0 resolves every control transfer in EX (2 bubbles when taken); BP_MODE=1 redirects JAL and backward branches from ID (1 bubble), repairs a misprediction from EX.

text.style: fill: #222222; font: italic 8.25px 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: FWD_PRECOMP=1 compares the forwarding selects in ID and registers them, so EX receives them from flops. Memories sit outside the core, without wait states.
